name: Rat
appearance: A small ordinary rat from the flooded nest inside Hightower.

Base creature rules.name: Climbing and swimming
Base creature rules.effectNote: The rat uses Dexterity for Climb and Swim checks. It can take 10 on either check even when threatened and can run while swimming in a straight line.

Encounters.name: Rat Race
Encounters.effectNote: Encounter Level 2. After everyone arrives in area 2, trigger the scene at the DM’s chosen time. Lightning floods a nest, and eight rats run in looking for an exit. Four have 2 HP each and four have 1 HP each. Each is CR 1/8.

Encounters.name: Flooded nest tactics
Encounters.effectNote: They attack the nearest targets they see, with at most three rats on one target. The bite still deals at least 1 damage. A rat that survives a hit flees on its next move action.

notes: The 3.5 Monster Manual p. 278 supplies the Tiny Animal base. Weapon Finesse. Space 2½ feet, reach 0 feet.
A Dark and Stormy Knight (Wizards of the Coast, 2005), p. 5 supplies the eight individual HP values and tactics.

name: Medium Monstrous Spider
appearance: A medium-sized web-spinning spider hidden among silk in the tor.

Base creature rules.name: Bite poison
Base creature rules.effectNote: Fortitude DC 12. Initial and secondary damage are each 1d4 Strength.

Base creature rules.name: Web throw
Base creature rules.effectNote: The web-spinner can throw a web up to eight times per day, as a net-like attack. Its range increment is 10 feet and maximum range is 50 feet. It can catch a target up to one size category larger. Escape Artist DC 12 or Strength DC 16 to get free.

Base creature rules.name: At home in its web
Base creature rules.effectNote: The spider moves across its web at climb speed and can pinpoint creatures touching it.

Encounters.name: What a Tangled Web
Encounters.effectNote: Encounter Level 1. This is one CR 1 spider with 11 HP. The ceiling web gives it Hide +15 and Move Silently +11 in this encounter.

Encounters.name: Doorway web
Encounters.effectNote: Spot DC 20 to notice the web. It has DR 5/—, 6 HP, break DC 16, and Escape Artist DC 12. Only one creature can be caught at once. A creature that touches the web is caught as in a net and cannot move away from the doorway. A weapon that touches it sticks and needs a DC 16 Strength check to free.

Encounters.name: Ceiling ambush
Encounters.effectNote: The spider attacks, with surprise if possible, when someone is caught in or attacks the doorway web. It always attacks the nearest target. It throws a web only when no character is currently entangled in a web.

notes: The 3.5 Monster Manual pp. 288–289 supply the Medium Vermin web-spinner base. Intelligence is shown as a dash. Weapon Finesse is a bonus feat. Space and reach 5 feet.
A Dark and Stormy Knight (Wizards of the Coast, 2005), pp. 5–6 supplies the encounter’s web placement, skill totals and tactics.
